model.encoding: one-hot fit on each training partition, drop=None, handle_unknown=ignore

legacy_diagnostic.meaning: Scores trained for any casualty, rescored against three labels. These are not three outcome-specific trained models; no retraining or prospective inference.

cluster_uncertainty.unit: operator, shared over outcomes, windows, specifications and validation modes
cluster_uncertainty.draw_generator: numpy PCG64 multinomial(G, 1/G), sorted string operator IDs
cluster_uncertainty.zero_rule: Zero positives: AP/recall undefined, hits zero. Empty window: all three undefined. Aggregate AP requires all four windows; aggregate recall uses all-window positive denominator.
cluster_uncertainty.scope: Fixed scores; no refitting. Joint operator composition sensitivity. Percentile 95% intervals are pointwise exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted. Training, feature-collection, snapshot and deployment uncertainty are not covered.

interpretation: Registered exploratory fixed-method information comparison in previously seen, reported incidents. Not causal location importance, not prospective field performance, and not an intervention recommendation.
